receipt.public_excerpt: In the last three months, we have disrupted five covert IO that sought to use our models in support of deceptive activity across the internet.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI reports that state-linked and commercial influence operations used its models to make deceptive political content. That is the misinformation use. OpenAI also says the campaigns gained little reach, but the claim is only that the use happened.

receipt.public_excerpt: The FBI is warning the public that criminals exploit generative artificial intelligence (AI) to commit fraud on a larger scale which increases the believability of their schemes.

evidence_items.explanation: An official FBI advisory, issued three days before the post, says criminals use generative AI for fraud. That is the scams use.

evidence_items.locator: Key Findings, AI and predictive technologies section

receipt.public_excerpt: the report documents these plans testing and deploying a series of artificial intelligence, automation and/or predictive technology tools. The result was most of these tools generated more denials.

evidence_items.explanation: This summarizes the October 2024 Senate subcommittee report. It found that the large Medicare Advantage insurers deployed AI and predictive tools that produced more denials of post-acute care in 2019-2022. That is the insurance-denial use.

receipt.public_excerpt: UnitedHealth denied all claims that nH Predict is used for coverage determinations, according to HealthCare Drive.

evidence_items.explanation: UnitedHealth disputes that its AI tool makes coverage decisions. This qualifies, but does not refute, the Senate finding that AI tools drove more denials.
